einzeiler: How to deal with people who resist change and what to do instead.
kurzfassung: Mel discusses why people resist change and how to handle difficult relationships. Dr. Dolly Chugh shares research-backed tools from NYU to help influence others and navigate frustration. The conversation explores strategies for better communication and personal habit change.
stichpunkte: Three methods to help when someone you love will not change
A simple question to ask before giving advice to prevent it from backfiring
A four-option question to determine what someone needs during difficult moments
A relationship tool to prevent small problems from escalating into major fights
How helping someone can sometimes keep them stuck
Two brain mechanisms that explain resistance to change
The role of unlearning in changing habits and behaviors
beschreibung:
There’s someone in your life you wish would change.

You’ve pushed, reminded, and given advice. You’ve had the same conversation over and over.

And somehow, you’re still stuck in the same frustrating cycle of fighting, nagging, lecturing, and hoping they’ll finally do something differently.

There is a better way.

In today’s conversation, Mel sits down with renowned behavioral scientist and award-winning NYU professor Dr. Dolly Chugh to unpack the surprising science of why people resist change and what really works.

You’re going to walk away with some of the most powerful, research-backed tools Dr. Chugh teaches at NYU – tools that will change how you see difficult people, frustrating relationships, and your own ability to influence how others behave.

You’ll learn:

-The 3 things that really do help when someone you love won’t change

-The simple question to ask before giving advice – so it doesn’t backfire

-The 4-option question that reveals what someone needs from you in a difficult moment

-The relationship tool that keeps small problems from turning into 10-out-of-10 fights

-How to tell when “helping” someone is keeping them stuck

-The 2 “bodyguards” in your brain that explain why you know better but still don’t do better

-Why your brain can fight change even when you desperately want it

-The surprising role “unlearning” plays in changing a habit or behavior

If you’re exhausted from trying to change someone you love, this conversation will give you a different way forward – starting today – that feels lighter, more hopeful, and extremely doable.

Your relationships will never be the same. And neither will you.
